$description: Canonical protein-coding gene complement per assembly target — the completeness yardstick an annotation is measured against (spec §4.3, §9 item 12). Distinct from assets/loci.json (which barcodes are) and from refs/<version>/proteins/ (which sequences are aligned): this is the list of expected gene *names*. `protein_coding_aliases` maps a canonical symbol to the /gene qualifier spellings seen in RefSeq GenBank records (case-insensitive; an 'MT-' locus prefix, as used by vertebrate mitogenome records, is stripped before matching).

animal_mt.name: metazoan_37
animal_mt.description: Canonical metazoan mitogenome: 13 PCG, 22 tRNA, 2 rRNA

plant_pt.name: angiosperm_plastome_79
plant_pt.description: Canonical land-plant plastome protein-coding complement: ~79 PCG, ~30 tRNA, 4 rRNA (8 loci with the inverted repeat)

plant_mt.description: Canonical angiosperm mitogenome protein-coding complement: ~41 PCG. Built from mitochondrial CDS records only — see NUPT discipline in task 29.
